findings.summary: Contents fire claim settled at £29,780 but the contents sum insured is £25,000. Most payable is the sum insured less the £100 excess. £5,000 interim already paid; balance must be cut.

Incident on 5 Sep 2026 predates the policy first being taken out (first_incepted and cover_start 8 Sep, comparison-site sale). Not covered, despite status Active; settlement of £4,120 agreed in error.

Declined under H-5.1 (wear and tear), but the plumber's report on file says the tap hose burst suddenly and the cabinet and floor were previously sound. Evidence contradicts the clause; accept under H-2.2. Complaint CMP-001 wrongly not upheld.

Theft settled in full (£4,048, paid) with evidence Insufficient: no crime reference and no proof of ownership or value for laptop (£1,849), phone (£1,099) or gold chain (£1,200). Settled to hit the 10-day target.
Escape of water excess of £350 deducted from both the interim (£1,500) and the final payment (£3,240): £700 taken. Policyholder has received £4,040 net, £350 short of the £4,390 due. Refund £350.

SUP-17 drying invoice DRN-08562/2 (£2,184, 3 dehumidifiers and 2 air movers, 12-18 Sep) duplicates DRN-08562 on CLM-0033: same amount, equipment and hire dates. Both paid. Refer before further payment; if duplicate, remove £2,184 here.
SUP-17 invoice DRN-08562 (£2,184, 12-18 Sep) matches DRN-08562/2 on CLM-0038 in amount, equipment and hire dates; paid on both claims. Validation to decide which claim the work belongs to.

Complaint CMP-005 upheld and £100 paid because a courtesy car 'should have been provided under the policy', but POL-0035 has no optional covers and the wording has no courtesy car clause. Check the basis for the outcome and redress.
